Players Committee card image of [[Rey (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E4), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots. When deployed, may take any card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. Your total battle destiny here is +1. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 6 if on Jakku).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/rey_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/4ab16f9b9c15499d865b4a7165ea8ddb0f451253 4ab16f9] (3 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
